title: sporobolus compositus var. drummondii
intro: Sporobolus compositus var. drummondii, commonly known as Drummond's grass, is a type of perennial grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits such as soothing bronchial irritations and reducing fever. The therapeutic actions of Sporobolus compositus var. drummondii include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which help to alleviate symptoms of coughs, colds, and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
